data.name: Branding Pattern
data.description: As a swift action, you can manipulate the pattern of one enemy to "mark" them as a ranged touch attack.  Until your next turn, each time you make a successful attack against that enemy, you deal an additional %1 points of hit point damage.|BrandingPatternDamage
